content: Perplexica (OSS Perplexity alt): query -> SearXNG meta-search (70+ engines, no tracking) -> collect top results -> embedding-based reranking -> LLM synthesizes answer with NUMBERED INLINE CITATIONS + source sidebar. Six focus modes (Web/Academic/YouTube/Reddit/News/Wolfram). Quality mode runs multiple search rounds with more ctx. Bundles frontend+backend orchestrator+Redis cache+local LLM. Sets the citation/freshness UX bar for self-hosted grounded search.
